captions.detailed: A compact power-zoom camera lens featuring a matte black outer barrel, a front focus ring with fine ribbed textures, and a dark blue glass front element. On the side of the main barrel is a small pivoting zoom rocker switch. The lens is designed with three moving parts: the inner optical tube translates linearly along the Z-axis, the focus ring rotates continuously around the lens axis, and the zoom rocker tilts on a short local hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a parametric 3D model of a compact power-zoom camera lens. The assembly must include a main outer barrel, a ribbed focus ring at the front that rotates continuously, an inner lens tube that extends prismatically along the optical axis, and a small zoom rocker switch on the side of the barrel that pivots on a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining four distinct parts: the outer barrel (base link), the focus ring, the inner tube, and the zoom rocker. The outer barrel is built using a primary cylinder with a hollowed center. The focus ring is modeled as a slightly larger cylinder with a ribbed outer surface, attached via a continuous joint. The inner tube is created as a smaller concentric cylinder with a glass disk visual representation at its tip, connected via a prismatic joint. The zoom rocker is a small box-based switch attached to the side of the barrel via a revolute joint with defined angular limits.
